text.description_html:
Acorn IKYBP, Square Cabinet Knob With Lines

It is easy to say that something made of iron with a black finish is traditional, but that is not really the case with Acorn's Square Cabinet Knob With Diagonal Lines. True, it is hand forged using the traditional art of the anvil and hammer but this cabinet knob has a contemporary feel despite using traditional methods and materials. It is perfect for the eclectic home.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Square Cabinet Knob With Diagonal Lines:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 1-1/4" square
  • Projection: 1"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
